verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents broad API coverage across its core product surfaces: connected accounts, card issuing and authorization controls, bills, card expenses, transfers and batch transfers, FX, Global Accounts and webhooks. A CLI, typed SDKs and an agent toolkit (AgentOS) sit on top of these APIs. The evidence never claims UI–API parity, though, and some APIs look narrower than a full UI workflow; for example, the Card Expenses API only retrieves approved expenses and marks them synced. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or matrix showing API/UI feature parity, evidence that workflows like expense submission and approval are available via API, and independent hands-on confirmation that nothing is UI-only.
